Game Overview

In Throwy, the core idea is straightforward: leap into the whimsical world of Throwy, where vibrant visuals and adorable characters await. Master intuitive tap controls to navigate enchanting platforms, collecting stars with perfect timing. Enjoy a calming yet engaging journey, where strategic jumps and charming animations make every level a delightful adventure.
